hypothesis.h0: Deriving readiness, blocking and satisfaction from canonical facts (D) does not lower incorrect scheduling decisions per 100 dispatches against mutable workflow status fields (M).
hypothesis.h1: Condition D lowers incorrect scheduling decisions per 100 dispatches by at least 50% relative to M under injected faults.

falsification: Derived state is retained only if D shows at least a 50% relative reduction in incorrect scheduling decisions per 100 dispatches against M, over 150 trials per condition (30 workload items x 5 seeds), giving 30 trials per fault case per condition, with the 95% BCa interval on the paired ratio excluding 1.0. Below 50%, or with an interval including 1.0, mutable status fields are retained and derivation is reduced to a reporting view. D worse than M on any single fault case is filed as a defect and the experiment is re-run after the fix.

conditions.description: readiness, blocking and satisfaction derived from canonical facts

workloads: 30 repository-level Missions from the Gordian workload corpus
population.sampling: paired on the workload item; each trial injects exactly one fault case, drawn round-robin so every case receives 30 trials per condition

strata.boundary: one canonical event dropped before projection
one canonical event delivered after a later event
an ExecutionAttempt terminates without a candidate
a candidate's exact state id changes after evidence was recorded
a hard dependency is added or removed mid-Mission

effect_size.measure: paired ratio of rates, D over M

analysis_plan.uncertainty: BCa bootstrap 95% CI, 10000 resamples, resampling seed recorded

exclusion_rule: A trial is excluded when the harness crashes before the first dispatch, when the model endpoint returns a transport error on more than 10% of the calls in that trial, or when the workload item's fixture repository fails its own pre-flight test. Excluded trials are retained with their reason and counted in the report. The rule is applied by script before the primary metric is inspected and never by judgement.

environment.source_commit: pinned at run time; the exact commit is recorded in each run.json

threats: adjudication of an incorrect dispatch by an observer rather than by replay; the adjudicator replays the event history and never inspects the status field under test
fault cases unevenly distributed across conditions; the round-robin draw is seeded and identical across arms
